test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(289, 192, 95)

(375, 278, 181)
solution:
The logic followed here is: 

(289, 192, 95)

⇒ 289 − 97 = 192(2nd number)

⇒ 192 − 97 = 95(3rd number)

(375, 278, 181)

⇒ 375 − 97 = 278(2nd number)

⇒ 278 − 97 = 181(3rd number)

Now,

Option 1) (421, 324, 225)

⇒ 421 − 97 = 324 (2nd number)

⇒ 324 − 97 = 227(not equal to 3rd number)

Option 2) (420, 324, 227)

⇒ 420 − 97 = 323(not equal to 2nd number)

⇒ 324 − 97 = 227(3rd number)

**Option 3) (421, 324, 227)**

**⇒ 421 − 97 = 324(2nd number)

⇒ 324 − 97 = 227(3rd number)**

Option 4) (421, 322, 227)

⇒ 421 − 97 = 324 (not equal to 2nd number)

⇒ 322 − 97 = 225(not equal to 3rd number)** **

Hence, the correct answer is Option 3.
